conditions.original: as written, with the prepended name
conditions.full: the applicant's own (prepended) name and the person names dslim/bert-base-NER finds -> 'the candidate', gendered pronouns -> 'they', replacements in lowercase, the rest as written (deid_transforms.deidentify variant 'full', lowercase=False)

design.relevance: a résumé is relevant iff its corpus category is the query's
design.metrics: per set; ties at their average rank, top-1 credit shared among tied leaders

names.source: name table names_gender.csv (pct_female column, percent scale)
